videoEditingDetails.description: A green tick mark with text 'খাতনানির্দেশ মাদ্রাসা' appears in the top right corner, followed by a transition to a red screen with a white circle at 0:30.
Animated intro sequence with text and Islamic-themed music, including multiple transitions between colored screens with text.

activities.description: Speaker sits on the steps of the house.
He takes a green plastic pitcher (Lota).
Removes his sandals and rolls up his sleeves.
Begins Wudu, starting with washing his hands and forearms up to the elbows.
Rinses his mouth three times, inhales water into his nose and exhales forcefully three times.
Washes his right arm up to the elbow three times.
Washes his left arm up to the elbow three times.
Wipes his head and ears, including the back of his neck.
Washes his right and left foot including the ankles.
Recites the Kalima (Islamic declaration of faith).
